title: SKE Crystal  Blueberry Cherry Cranberry Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: SKE Crystal Blueberry Cherry Cranberry Nic Salt brings together three bold fruit notes in a layered, vibrant profile. Sweet Blueberry lays the foundation with its jammy richness, while Cherry adds depth and a subtle sharpness. Cranberry rounds out the blend with a tart, slightly dry edge that adds clarity and contrast to the overall vape. This flavour is designed for vapers who enjoy fruit blends with a bit of bite ”complex without being heavy, and full of character. Each fruit brings its own nuance to the mix, creating a dynamic blend that keeps things interesting with every puff. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) kits such as pod systems and starter devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it delivers a smooth throat hit with efficient nicotine absorption. SKE is renowned for delivering bold, satisfying flavours with sleek, user-friendly design. Their Crystal Bar disposables helped set a new standard for flavour clarity and convenience, and the SKE Crystal Nic Salt range continues that legacy "offering the same popular flavours in a format compatible with a wide range of refillable pod kits and MTL vape devices. With a presence in over 50 countries, SKE remains at the forefront of vaping innovation.
